notes: Replaced Caffeine-based createVertexCache/createEdgeCache with plain ConcurrentHashMap(128) in both CachingAgeGraphOperations and CachingNeo4jGraphOperations. Read caches remain Caffeine (6 read caches preserved). invalidateAll() now calls .clear() on the maps; invalidateReads() unchanged. Geomean dropped from baseline 0.01682 us/op to 0.01052 us/op (~37% improvement). createVertex ~2.2-2.4 ns, createEdge ~9.2-9.3 ns — both substantially faster than round 6 baseline (13-16 ns create, 41 ns createEdge). TTL/maxSize loss on write caches acknowledged — explicit invalidation on delete/update preserves correctness. Build + both JMH benchmark suites ran clean. Commit 41d3f56 on experiment/round_7_executor_b.
